Package Galaxy Plot

Source: R/pkg_galaxy_plot.R
pkg_galaxy_plot.Rd

Draws a colorful "galaxy" of your installed packages: each package is placed along a golden-angle spiral, colored by which library it lives in, and (optionally) sized by its on-disk footprint. Purely decorative, but a nice way to see how many packages you have and how they're spread across your libraries.

Usage

pkg_galaxy_plot(sizes = TRUE)

Arguments

sizes

TRUE (default) scales point size by each package's footprint on disk (computed with fs::dir_info()). FALSE draws every point the same size, which is much faster.

Value

Invisibly returns the data.frame used to draw the plot, with one row per installed package.

Examples

# \donttest{
pkg_galaxy_plot(sizes = FALSE)

# }
